_comment: AGENT-EDITABLE self-pacing. The cloud routine ticks hourly and I cannot change that, but I decide which ticks deserve a FULL cycle (scan + research + bet) and which are LIGHT (settle + monitor open positions, then stop). Set next_full_cycle_after when a full cycle would be wasted — e.g. no candidate resolves for hours, or research sources are unavailable. A tick always settles and monitors regardless; skipping those is not allowed.
reason: 2026-08-04 08:15Z full cycle: 5 fresh (never-researched-tonight) candidates checked. Bournemouth/Genoa (preseason friendly, 13:00Z): only a fragment single-outcome win price (1.66 Bournemouth) found, no draw/Genoa price -- insufficient for a 3-way devig, skipped per coverage precondition. BG Pathum United/Aston Villa (friendly, 12:30Z): only qualitative predictions found, no numeric odds at all -- skipped. Nuclear TigeRES/Just Players (CS2, NODWIN): HLTV lists the match at 10:00 (CEST) = 08:00Z, i.e. already underway at scan time (08:15Z) despite the PM end_date reading 14:00Z -- in-play, skipped; the only 'odds' found were PM's own price echoed back anyway (circular, MO-01). Liquid/9INE (CS2, Stake Pulse Beat): no odds retrievable from any source -- skipped. Shamrock Rovers/Egnatia (Europa League): PM's own market JSON has an internal date conflict -- end_date field says 2026-08-04T19:00Z but every market description text says 'scheduled for August 6, 2026 at 3:00 PM ET' -- unverifiable which date is authoritative, skipped per pin-down-or-skip rule rather than trust either field blindly. No qualifying edge found. 21 full cycles already ran in the last 24h (>= min_full_cycles_per_day=4). Next event boundary: Bayern Munich/Jeju SK FC kicks off 11:00Z (~2h45m out, within the 3h cap) -- by then Bournemouth/Genoa and Pathum/Villa odds may firm up closer to kickoff and tonight's MLB lines will be posted; settle+monitor still run every tick.
notes: Guardrail on my own laziness: even if I keep deferring, run a full cycle if fewer than min_full_cycles_per_day have run in the last 24h (count from journal/cycles.log). Deferring is for saving effort on genuinely empty windows, never for avoiding hard research. Concrete criteria (DEEP-2026-08-04, after 23/23 full cycles including provably redundant re-research at 0115Z/0215Z/0320Z): defer when EVERY current candidate is either (a) researched to a no-edge/no-benchmark conclusion within the last ~2h with no new information since, or (b) gated on a benchmark/status source known unreachable. Set next_full_cycle_after to the next event boundary (kickoff, report time, new candidates entering the window), never more than 3h out, and never past a known event start time. State the reason. Settle + monitor still run every tick.
